guard.old:
# Codex's unified Bash tool does not expose Claude's run_in_background flag.
    # Instead, long shell calls are handed back as native background-terminal/session
    # handles while the model can keep reasoning; the PreToolUse payload carries a
    # Codex turn_id and no Claude transcript_path. Treat ONLY a native watch command
    # as asynchronously observable on that surface. Hand-written sleep/poll loops stay
    # denied because they waste quota even if the terminal itself backgrounds.
    codex_native = bool(payload.get("turn_id")) and payload.get("transcript_path") is None
guard.new:
# Codex hands long Bash calls back through native session handles. Its
    # documented turn_id is a nonempty string; transcript_path may be a string
    # or null on BOTH surfaces and cannot classify Claude versus Codex.
    # This identifies the existing watch capability, not authentication/grants.
    # Explicit intervals, observation-only scope and cooldowns still apply.
    codex_native = (isinstance(payload.get("turn_id"), str)
                    and bool(payload["turn_id"].strip()))

context.old:
- CEO/orchestrator CI waits are asynchronous: after one bounded state read, bind exactly one background/native watcher to the exact PR/head/run or rely on the repository's existing merge sweeper, then immediately continue another independent authorized lane.
- Never foreground `gh run watch`, `gh run view --watch`, or `gh pr checks --watch` in a principal turn and never emulate them with repeated sleep/poll rounds. The watcher event is the next CI observation; ownership of repair/merge/live proof remains with the original operation.
context.new:
- CI observation must have a verified return path: a request or PreToolUse admission is not a running watcher. Retain the successful tool return, exact PR/head/run, handle and supported result-consumption path. Never invent an idle wake; consume the same handle at a useful boundary when needed.
- REDUNDANT POLL is a finite read cooldown, not a permanent permission denial. No sleep/retry, alternate reader, state reset or mutation to clear it. If no verified observer supplies completion, one bounded same-carrier read is eligible at the next real integration boundary or existing scheduled wake after expiry. Genuine permission, safety and effect-unknown holds remain binding.
- A self-written checkpoint is not an external completion source. Two no-progress wakes require diagnosis of the missing observation/return path and a changed tactic. Reuse the existing Class-M backoff (15m -> 30m -> 60m; default 60m), keep unchanged results quiet and ask a necessary human question only once.
